691: ComplexTypes that are extended PET types are special types and are allowed. Legacy types that are no longer used or types defined for future use are prohibited. This CERT is checked using programmatic methods by assessing if all types (simpleTypes and complexTypes) are used with allowance for PET derived types as noted.
988: With PETs, an alternate method for using a choice type is available through the use of Polymorphism in UCI. With a controlled set of complexTypes, defined elsewhere in the UCI XSD Schema, an element declared using a PET type allows access to all derived types. PETs have also been used in UCI to address support for multiple versions of formatting standards such as NITF or STANAG 4607 by allowing the overloading of options for different versions. Two examples are NITF_PackingPlanPET and STANAG_4607_PackingPlanPET.
